tips: | One of the hardest counters for Samira, because your champ has no poke she gets a free lane (bonus XP for her and her support from passive), there is nothing to block with your Blade Whirl, her Jubilant Veil can deny you getting Style-grades (she is immune to the one second S-tier combo), if she saves her ult she can just interrupt yours.
| Her long range + slows make it hard to autospace/trade, however she is unmobile so the matchup becomes easy if you have a hook support (extremely hard if you lack engage).

| This matchup is only hard if the Aphelios is good (which is rare). Just respect him level 1 (he has long range and better sustain so trading level 1 is really troll). Avoid fighting him when he has chakrams and you're completely fine. Once again easy matchup if you have a hook support since he is unmobile. NOTE: you cannot block Severum attacks since they are not projectiles!
| Pretty much just like Ashe and Aphelios, just respect her early and look for all-ins because she is unmobile. Be patient and try not to get poked too much.

| Extremely unplayable for Samira since her Miasma completely destroys you. She also has better trades on lane. You also lose all-ins if she hits her Q. Have to look for all-ins after level 6 if she wastes her Miasma.

| My personal permaban so I never play the matchup. You lose trades because he has way more base damage than you. If he holds his E for your ult you can never win, very winnable if he completely wastes it.

| IMPORTANT NOTE: this matchup completely depends on how smart/good the Ezreal is. A bad Ezreal is not a threat for you. A good Ezreal never Arcane Shifts forward and is therefore unkillable for you, also you just get outpoked/outranged by him. The matchup becomes very winnable if he is cocky with his E usage.
| He has better laning tools and longer range and for some reason you cannot block his Deadly Flourish. He lacks mobility so an engage support makes the matchup much easier.

| Once again a long range unmobile (if we don't count her passive movespeed from kills) champion that is pretty easy to all-in with engage supports. Just keep in mind that you cannot dash through her Flame Chompers.

| Actual somewhat good matchup for once, she doesn't really outrange you and doesn't have crazy base damage in the earlygame. Just avoid fighting when isolated (evolved Icathian Rain hurts when you're alone).

| She is the strongest earlygame ADC in the game and Samira is one of the worst. Avoid risky fights early and pray for your jungler to camp your lane. If you don't get any help from your team she will have 15+ kills. If you avoid fighting you easily outscale her though.

| Easy to all-in since he is unmobile and has no hard CC. Laning is just annoying because he has better poke and pushes waves fast. NOTE: do not level up Blade Whirl until level 4 since he has no projectiles other than autoattacks (if the enemy support has a hook then you can level it up at level 3).
| Just instantly back off when he uses his W, wait for it to run out and look for a possible fight. Extremely easy to all-in with a CC support if he has no peel.

| He easily pokes you through minions with Piercing Light because you cannot block it, also a bit harder to all-in if he has Relentless Pursuit ready to go. However if he wastes it he becomes an easy target for your support.

| She has way better base damage so you lose early trades, avoid standing behind low HP minions. She has a lot of movespeed so landing CC might be hard for your support, however no dashes or blinks so once the CC hits she is an easy target.

| A good Senna easily bullies you in lane since you cannot block her autos or Piercing Darkness. She is extremely squishy so the matchup mostly depends on the support matchup. Very easy to snowball with a hook support.

| Really annoying to lane because she just oneshots waves and then you can get bullied under turret. However her Spellshield doesn't deny Style-grades even if it blocks an ability so you can all-in her with the one second S-tier combo if she steps up too close.
| She oneshots waves and outpokes you, must be punished early with strong all-ins. Best thing you can do later is blocking her ult.
| He has weak earlygame, no hard CC and very little mobility so stomping him in the first ~20 minutes is pretty easy, just keep in mind that he has really good scaling. Also you can block his ult.
| A bit like Seraphine but less range. Must be punished before level 6. Remember to get healing reduction!
| Try to block her Explosive Charge when she jumps on you since that's most of her damage. She is hard to all-in if she holds her ult for yours and she also has her jump to escape.

| This is only easy if he's AD, AP Twitch is much harder because you have to focus on blocking his Venom Cask. There's pretty much no poke so the lane is chill. Just be careful after level 6 because with proper kiting he easily outranges you. NOTE: you cannot block his E since it's not a projectile!
| It's a bit like Jhin, he has better laning tools and longer range so the earlygame can be hard, lacks mobility so all-ins are easy, block his ult if you can.

| Matchup depends a lot on how the Vayne uses her Condemn, if she holds it for your ult she can be hard to kill. You can try to bait it by not instantly ulting when you reach S-tier and you are near her. Lane should be pretty chill but she can poke you with Tumble attacks.
| Try to punish him when his cage is on cooldown, if you can't he just outscales you and you lose by default.

| She is the best "anti-all-in" ADC, it's all about blocking 3+ feathers so you don't get rooted. You can also get poked on lane because she has better laning tools. Try to make plays with your support when her ult is on cooldown.
| Make sure to bully him level 1, block tornados because there is nothing else to block. Avoid long fights because Lethal Tempo is OP on him. Avoid his E Q tornado if possible.
| Try to snowball pre-6 because she is squishy in the earlygame. After level 6 it becomes hard to kill her if you don't oneshot her, she just kites away with ult and then chases you down.
| Just like every mage, he has better laning tools, must be punished with early all-ins.

| Samira's main counter is non-projectile hard CC and that's all that Alistar has. Do not pull the Inferno Trigger if he has his E ticking next to you. You can also try to predict his engage by dodging it with Wild Rush.
| You can block one Bandage Toss but there's the problem; he has two, so try your hardest to just dodge it. In teamfights do not dash in if he still has ult.
| Don't stand behind so you don't get easily stunned by Cosmic Binding. Very vulnerable to all-in with a hook support.
| Block his Rocket Grab if you have to, fighting might be hard if he holds his ult since it can cancel you Inferno Trigger AND break your Immortal Shieldbow.
| Avoid standing around ablaze targets so you don't get poked by his E, block his Q if you are ablaze. Easy to all-in since he is unmobile.
| Stand behind minions so you don't get hit by Winter's Bite, otherwise you might need block it since it is a possible deathsentence, block his ult in teamfights.

| This matchup is absolutely unplayble if you don't have point and click CC engage or engage that ignores the turrets (Leona or Pantheon for example). You just get permashoved and poked and it's really hard unless you get some help from your team. Remember that in fights you can use his turrets to dash in or out with Wild Rush.

| The biggest enchanter counter for Samira, after level 6 you can never all-in her or her ADC because the moment you use Inferno Trigger she just instantly ults and you're doomed. If you manage to get an engage on her pre-6 try to block her tornado.

| If possible, don't leash against her, if you do and she doesn't the lane starts with you getting a Mantra Q in the face for free. In lane stand behind minions BUT not too close to them so you don't get hit by the AOE.
| Block Zenith Blade, it's the only thing you can do, after level 6 the matchup becomes very hard if you don't have proper peel, never engage on her unless the fight looks really free.

| She has really annoying poke in the earlygame, after level 6 all-ins become harder if she holds her ult for yours. Try to block her Polymorph if you can, the animation is very subtle so it can sometimes just be luck-based.
| A more annoying version of Morgana since her poke is much better. Very easy to all-in though.

| Just focus on blocking her Dark Binding and it's pretty easy, if Morgana counters your support's engage with her Black Shield the matchup might be hard to snowball from but it's not the end of the world.
| Just an easier version of the Lulu matchup, she has some annoying poke but her CC is easier to dodge/block.
| Just like Alistar, he counters you with unblockable hard CC, all you can do is block his hook. In teamfights do not engage before he uses his ult.

| He has extremely strong earlygame all-ins, using Cleanse for his W feels bad because then you don't have it for Exhaust (assuming that the enemy ADC has it). His Aegis Assault can deny Style-grades if he blocks your stuff.

| Really simple: Pyke has 2 hard CC spells and you can block them both, sometimes you might get hit by 1 but it shouldn't be possible to be hit by both if you didn't waste your Blade Whirl. NOTE: in this matchup it's very important to hold your level-up on level 2 in the case he tries to all-in you.

| This depends mostly on how the Rakan plays, he can be very aggressive with his Grand Entrance, or extremely defensive if he just holds it for your all-ins. The defensive playstyle counters you harder because it makes it impossible for you to get any kills.
| Once again, unblockable hard CC so in all-ins you can get destroyed, her cooldowns are long though so you can try to turn the fight after she used everything.

| She has some little poke early on but just take it slow and you counter her later in teamfights; her ult has an extremely slow animation and is very easy to block. Only problem is that her Bailout can deny you some resets and make your life harder.
| Kinda like Pantheon but not that bad because Sett's main CC is not point and click (talking about his E and not his ult). On lane be careful around bushes because he most likely has Hexflash.
| Her poke is not that bad because she is a scaling champion, extremely easy to all-in, try to block her ult if you can, the animation is very fast though so it can be hard.

| Like most enchanters, she can easily poke you on lane. Trading with her is not worth it. Take it easy and look for all-in windows. Just keep in mind that her silence can instantly cancel your Inferno Trigger. Remember to get healing reduction if your team is not already doing so.
| Like Rakan, this depends on how he plays. If he plays very defensively snowballing is pretty much impossible. Look to punish him if he uses his Abyssal Dive in a bad spot.
| Very hard to all-in because Taric has so much good peel, try to burst him before his ult goes off if possible. Build healing reduction.

| Block his hook if needed, all-ins can be hard if he saves his Flay for your ult. Try to punish him after he uses everything because his cooldowns are kinda long (assuming he missed his hook so he doesn't get bonus CDR).

| If you have an all-in support this should be free, just try not to get poked and then look for aggressive engages. Take Cleanse because there's like a 95% chance that either she or her ADC took Exhaust.
| Try to punish him pre-6 with heavy all-ins, after that snowballing becomes very hard, 2v2 is still doable if you get some good Inferno Trigger damage on both targets since he can only ult one.

| Very simple, your RANGED (NOT MELEE) Q instantly oneshots a plant so she can't really get any good poke on you. She is also extremely vulnerable to all-ins so this one of the easiest support matchups to snowball from.
| Not an ADC or a support but just generally one of Samira's hardest counters. His extreme tankiness, damage and CC make your life miserable.

| Not an ADC or a support but just generally one of Samira's hardest counters. He is very tanky, has tons of damage and of top of that he has 2 knockups that just make your teamfighting almost impossible.

| Not an ADC or a support but just generally one of Samira's hardest counters. His pillar can mess you up really badly and he takes AD and resists from you. A fed Trundle is impossible to play against for Samira.
| Only thing that can screw you up is his Q. Just watch out for it when you're engaging and you're good to go.

| Excellent support for Samira, just chill level 1 since you both are useless at that point. If he tries to knockback an enemy towards you with his W do NOT instantly autoattack them because that will cancel the knockback and instead knocks the target up for 0,5 seconds with your passive.

| Also very good since he provides engage and CC lock. Just keep in mind that a max range Bandage Toss is longer range than your passive dash on early levels so don't be too far away so you don't miss out on the engage.
| Not optimal but works if the enemy botlane doesn't have anything to punish Senna on lane. Has some little engage and sustain.
| Just a worse Senna, only provides some poke pre-6. With her arrow there is at least some all-in potential if she lands it.
| Not the best but also not the worst, good setup with Cosmic Binding but the Bard needs to be good (mainly just onetricks play him so should be ok).

| A less reliable Nautilus but still works really well, same thing as with Alistar W; do NOT instantly autoattack the enemy if he hits a max range hook because that will interrupt it and instead knocks the target up. Wait for the hook to finish and then attack.
| Works well if the Brand is good with Q stuns, if not you're kinda doomed since he doesn't provide any peel or other CC to follow up to.
| A bit awkward if the Braum doesn't hit many Q's, good engage after level 6 since you can follow up his ult with another knockup.
| In my opinion the best enchanter support for Samira, however the Janna needs to be really good with her tornados so you can follow up with your extra knockup. Having that AD shield also feels good.
| Not optimal but somewhat playable with her root as an engage. Decent peel.
| Really strong engage and CC lock. Just a solid pick overall.
| Just chill before level 6, after that you can look for an engage with Lulu ult into your passive knockup.
| Can be good if she first lands some good poke and then a Light Binding for you to all-in. Has some little peel with her shield.

| A bit like Brand, if she's good with bindings it works, if not she at least has some peel with Black Shield. Later in teamfights her job is to just shield you so you can get a good ult without getting interrupted.
| Can be really deadly if the Nami hits some good bubbles. Decent sustain on lane.
| Probably my personal favorite support to play with. Extremely deadly all-in and snowball potential. Easy to follow up.
| Kinda coinflip but excellent snowball potential from early fistfights. Gets countered easily by spellshields so a bad blind pick.
| A less tanky Nautilus and requires more skill. Extremely good snowball potential against unmobile botlaners.
| Solid engage and solid peel. Just a bit hard against mobile botlaners.
| Extremely deadly all-in if the Rell is good, the champ is just hard to pull off correctly so it's rarely played. Gets countered by mobile botlaners.
| In my opinion the second best enchanter for Samira. Has some engage CC to follow up to, Bailout allows you to make some risky plays.
| A bit like Senna, just a little bit more CC, good scaling if not punished on lane.
| A more tanky Pantheon, good snowball potential from early fistfights.

| Probably the worst support for Samira, doesn't really provide you anything other than small healing on lane. If you already locked/hovered Samira in champ select and they go Sona, just report them and dodge.
| Just like Sona but with a bit more sustain. I would just dodge and move on.
| Kinda like Morgana but worse peel. Can have some decent snowball potential if he lands some good E's.
| A worse Alistar because the engage is not so reliable, really good peel with his ult though.

| One of the best supports for Samira, it just requires good communication and synergy, as Taric charges his stun you can look for a dash through a minion to land the stun on enemy champions. Excellent peel in teamfights because you can just dive in with his ult without worrying about instantly dying.

| A less reliable Nautilus because the champ is too hard to play for most people, however a good Thresh makes the game really enjoyable. Remember to instantly react to his Flay so you can knock the enemy up with your passive.

| Believe it or not, before her rework she was actually one of the best enchanters for Samira, she gave you AD and strong level 6 engage. After the rework in patch 13.5 both of those things were removed and instead they gave her some mana and on-hit damage. Samira just doesn't need those so now Yuumi is one of the worst picks you can have.
| Decent if the Zilean hits some good stuns, with his ult you can make some risky plays just like with Renata Glasc. The speedboost goes really well in teamfights with your Inferno Trigger.
| In my opinion just a worse Brand, can work if she hits her CC, if not, you're doomed.
| For Samira he's pretty much a peel machine, his ult can be very useful but he doesn't really provide you the engage that you need.
